item.title: Scholar and Zenodo Pipeline Validation Post
item.description:
Summary

This temporary post validates the combined Genomics x AI Google Scholar metadata and Zenodo DOI pipeline on a feature branch.

This is an operational test article for the Genomics x AI publishing workflow.

It confirms that a newly accepted post can move through the manual test-publish workflow, receive Zenodo DOI metadata in the sandbox, build a preview page, and render Google Scholar-compatible citation metadata that includes the DOI.

This post should be removed from the branch before merge.
